'''The Institute of Mathematical Sciences''' ('''IMSc''') (sometimes also referred to as ''Matscience'') is a reputed [[research centre]] located in [[Chennai]], India.<ref name=reso>R. Jagannathan, ''The Institute of Mathematical Sciences'', Resonance (January 1999) vol. 4, no. 1, pp. 89-92, [http://www.ias.ac.in/resonance/Jan1999/pdf/Jan1999IA.pdf Complete Article].
</ref><ref name=hindu>{{cite news|last=Muthiah|first=S.|title=Ekamra Nivas to university|url=http://www.hindu.com/thehindu/mp/2005/05/23/stories/2005052300180300.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060915200314/http://www.hindu.com/thehindu/mp/2005/05/23/stories/2005052300180300.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=15 September 2006|access-date=23 January 2011|newspaper=[[The Hindu]]|date=23 May 2005}}</ref> It is a constituent institute of the [[Homi Bhabha National Institute]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=HBNI - The Beginning |url=http://www.hbni.ac.in/TheBeginning.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220810213821/http://www.hbni.ac.in/TheBeginning.html |archive-date=2022-08-10 |access-date=2023-07-20 |website=www.hbni.ac.in}}</ref>

IMSc is a national institute for fundamental research in frontier disciplines of the mathematical and physical sciences: [[theoretical computer science]], [[mathematics]], [[theoretical physics]], and [[computational biology]]. It is funded mainly by the [[Department of Atomic Energy]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.imsc.res.in/~office/officeinfo/ | title=Official disclosure under Right to Information Act| year=2005 | website=www.imsc.res.in}}.</ref> The institute operates the [[Kabru (supercomputer)|Kabru supercomputer]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.top500.org/list/2004/06/?page=3|title=TOP500 List - June 2004|date=June 2004|website=[[TOP500]]|access-date=2018-12-18|archive-date=18 December 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181218193732/https://www.top500.org/list/2004/06/?page=3|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==History==
The institute was founded by [[Alladi Ramakrishnan]] in 1962 in Chennai.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-08-30 |title=Alladi Ramakrishnan centenary conference in December |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/alladi-ramakrishnan-centenary-conference-in-december/article67250968.ece |access-date=2023-11-20 |issn=0971-751X}}</ref> It is modelled after the [[Institute for Advanced Study]], [[Princeton, New Jersey]], United States. It went through a phase of expansion when [[E. C. G. Sudarshan]] in the 1980s and R. Ramachandran in 1990s were the directors. Amritanshu Prasad is currently the director of the institute<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.imsc.res.in/about_imsc|title=About IMSc &#124; The Institute of Mathematical Sciences|website=www.imsc.res.in}}</ref>.

==Academics==
The institute has a graduate research program to which a group of students are admitted each year to work towards a Ph.D. degree. IMSc hosts scientists at the post-doctoral level and supports a visiting scientist program in areas of research in the institute.<ref name=reso/>

==Campus==
[[File:IMSc Chennai.jpg|thumb|Main Building, Tharamani, campus]]
Located in South Chennai, in the Adyar-Tharamani area, the institute is on the Central Institutes of Technology (CIT) campus.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=About IMSc {{!}} The Institute of Mathematical Sciences |url=https://www.imsc.res.in/about_imsc |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701112518/https://www.imsc.res.in/about_imsc |archive-date=2023-07-01 |access-date=2023-07-25 |website=www.imsc.res.in}}</ref> The institute maintains a student hostel, flatlets for long-term visitors, married students and post-doctoral fellows, and the institute guest house.<ref name=":0" /> IMSc has its own faculty housing in Thiruvanmiyur near the seashore.<ref name=":0" />
